kernel_evidence.source: external memory sentinel over canonical Darwin physical footprint
kernel_evidence.event: after a valid startup-to-steady handshake, the first isolated resident gradient graph rose from a post-load low-water baseline through 49984.3, 55030.4, 60298.8, and 63371.8 MB and was killed by the static steady ceiling before step completion

diagnosis.root_cause: The CP186 handshake correctly separated model load from training but still applied the low-water 59392-MB ceiling while a legitimate single gradient graph was live. The low-water threshold is appropriate between graphs, not during one graph's bounded activation lifetime.
diagnosis.repair: Require a hash-chained external compute lease for every training and holdout graph. Acquire only from an independently observed <=59392-MB baseline, guard the isolated graph and drain at 73728 MB, then require a create-once release request and independent return to <=59392 MB before checkpointing or acquiring another graph. Sample every 0.5 seconds, kill immediate overshoot at 1.05x, and retain the complete 13-hour ring.
